budgets.note: 2026-11-16 实测校准（不是为了让门禁变绿，是把预算定在可实现的位置）：Blender kit 件天然 24–1000 面；AI 图生 3D（trellis2 512 档）原始 0.97–1.07M 面，weld+gltf-simplify(error 2%) 只能到 ~50 万，Blender merge-by-distance(0.0015)+Decimate 后 6k–101k，受 UV 分裂拓扑限制再砍就破面。因此 triPerProp 定为 65k（AI 单件），triPerBuilding 仍 10k（kit）。真正的运行期硬门禁是 triTotalScene / drawCallsMax / fpsMin —— 这三条不动。 | 2026-11-17 二轮：10 件 Hunyuan3D PBR 资产+1 绑骨角色实测 9.1MB（zip 12MB<100MB，本地 boot<1s，fps60/DrawCall38/三角189k 全在硬门禁内），故总量预算 6.2→9.6MB；fps/DrawCall/三角三条硬门禁不动。 | 单贴图预算 220→400KB：512px PBR 实测 290–370KB/件。 | 角色预算：Hunyuan3D+band-rig 实测 9998 tri/1.75MB（256px 贴图），triPerCharacter 9k→11k、glbMaxKB 900→1900。 | 三轮写实化：贴图 1024px 保真（建筑/角色），总量预算 13MB；硬门禁 fps/DrawCall/三角 不变。

prompt.positive: photorealistic RAW photograph, shot on 35mm lens f/4, natural available light, real-world weathered materials with micro detail, single isolated object centered, plain dark studio backdrop, soft even lighting with warm rim, no text, no watermark, no illustration, no cartoon
prompt.negative: cartoon, stylized, low poly, illustration, painting, text, watermark, logo, background clutter, multiple objects, plastic look

categories.prop: three-quarter hero view of one isolated handheld prop object, filling 72% of frame, crisp silhouette, sharp focus on material detail
categories.building: three-quarter view of one isolated modular village building piece on invisible floor plane, straight horizontal horizon, filling 80% of frame
categories.character: full body character turnaround sheet, neutral A-pose, plain studio background, consistent proportions, front view
categories.texture: seamless tileable material texture, flat top-down orthographic view, even diffuse lighting, no objects, no vignette, no seams
categories.poster: cinematic key art, wide 16:9 composition, layered depth, small silhouetted keeper carrying a glowing lantern on a wet stone path toward a lit lighthouse, storm clouds over the sea

postProcess: 全场景共用 roughness/metalness 区间
照片级概念图一律 krea2 出，禁止手绘风关键词
